answer: Staked curation admits no bare claim: a curator posts a lotus endorsement and locks 60 credits for that identity, at most three per epoch. A glacier audit samples 10 percent, rechecks source records, and on fraud burns that bond and the curator's other live bonds. The k-th fake needs a fresh bond and slot, so 1,000 fakes need 334 curators and 60,000 credits, no bond reusable. An honest agent needs one curator and one 60 bond, refunded if clean. A pulse check forces re-signing with a fresh nonce, so rented endorsements fail: a curator that never saw the work cannot re-sign.
